remediation.task: Refactor event bus to use Redis Pub/Sub for cross-instance distribution
remediation.before: In-process EventEmitter only — events could not reach other instances
remediation.after: emit() publishes to Redis channel 'snakzap:events' after in-process dispatch. initEventSubscriber() subscribes with onMessage callback. MemoryRedis.subscribe() is a no-op callback-compatible.

remediation.task: Add fail-closed rate limiter on critical routes
remediation.before: All rate limiters were fail-open — Redis failures allowed traffic through
remediation.after: failClosed option on RateLimiterOptions. checkRateLimit returns { allowed: false, current: -1 } on Redis failure when failClosed: true. Rate limiter middleware returns 503 (not 429) when current === -1.
remediation.routes: OTP limiter (auth.ts), paymentsLimiter (payments.ts), adminWriteLimiter (admin.ts: 9 write endpoints)
remediation.verification: New test in rateLimiter.test.ts proves 503 (allowed: false, current: -1) when Redis fails with failClosed: true. General API limiter stays fail-open.
